messages:
tia-sre: Heads-up: eu-west dedicated pool spike — 99p latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s over the last 10m. Looks like capacity saturation + noisy tenant. Starting triage. @raj-runtime can you pull kernel selection logs and KV eviction rates?

raj-runtime: On it. quick summary from the metrics: throughput dropped ~30%, queue length up on alloc service, a bunch of small microbatches observed. I see repeated kernel fallback events to `kernel_safe_v2` around the time of the spike. Suspect quantized kernel mismatch on longer sequences. Pasting relevant excerpt: 

```
# kernel-selection.log
[13:18:07] tenant=team-gamma model=gpt-open-3 quant=4bit selected=fast_kernel_v1
[13:18:09] tenant=team-gamma model=gpt-open-3 quant=4bit fallback=kernel_safe_v2 reason=oom_estimate
[13:18:09] tenant=team-alpha model=gpt-open-1 quant=fp16 selected=fast_kernel_v1
[13:18:11] tenant=team-gamma evict_kv=true kv_evictions=120
```

lina-ml: KV eviction count is huge relative to baseline. On our traces, tenant=team-gamma has very long histories (10k tokens) causing KV thrash. The cache hit ratio dropped from 92% -> 56% at spike. That explains per-token latency increase.

oliver-platform: I also see placement pressure — some hosts hit slot limits and we started scheduling onto smaller instances, which forces different kernel path (no tensor cores). That causes the expensive fallback Raj saw. I think there's a quota misconfig: the tenant had `burst=unbounded` in the reserved-policy unexpectedly.

sophia-oncall: Confirming: alerting rule triggered at 13:19 and a paging loop ran to rotate pods, didn't help. Paging log: `alloc-retry x3 -> host chosen small-gpu-c`.

tia-sre: Ok step 1: throttle the noisy tenant to baseline. @oliver-platform can you apply a quick policy patch to limit team-gamma burst to 2x reserved? If possible, also pin them off the eu-west1-hot hosts.

oliver-platform: Patching now. Applying policy change: 

```
PATCH /policy/reserved/team-gamma
{ "burst_multiplier": 2 }
```

deploy-bot: deploy start: policy-service patch 2143001248 by oliver-platform
deploy-bot: deploy success: policy-service 2143001266

raj-runtime: After policy change: kernel fallbacks dropped, KV eviction rate down to ~18/min (was 120/min). But we still see small batch sizes being created because the runtime's batching heuristic detected high tail latency and reduced batch windows. That reduced throughput — we need to rebalance batching window now that cache behavior stabilized.

lina-ml: I profiled a representative request before and after:

```
# sample profile
before: token_latency=0.98ms kernel_exec=0.72ms kv_wait=0.15ms retry_wait=0.1ms
after:  token_latency=0.28ms kernel_exec=0.22ms kv_wait=0.03ms retry_wait=0.01ms
```

tia-sre: Good. Proposed next steps: 1) keep throttled policy on team-gamma for 2h, 2) run a targeted rollout of the improved batching heuristic (increase max_batch_window from 8ms -> 18ms) in eu-west dedicated pools only, 3) add a permanent quota audit to detect `unbounded` burst configs. Agree?

raj-runtime: +1 for rollout. I will stage the batching heuristic change behind a feature flag and enable for eu-west1 first. Also adding a guard: if KV eviction > 50/min for a tenant, cap its burst automatically.

oliver-platform: I'll open a change to placement affinity to avoid mixing long-history tenants with small-host pool. Suggest marking team-gamma as high-kv-pressure.

sophia-oncall: I'll keep watch. Noting for the post-incident doc: SLA blip lasted ~22 minutes total, customer-facing impact minimal but internal SLO breached at 99p for 18 minutes.

tia-sre: Nice work. Quick action items summary (pinging people):
- raj-runtime: feature-flag rollout for batch-window + auto-cap on KV eviction (ETA 4h)
- oliver-platform: permanent policy audit + placement affinity change (ETA EOD)
- lina-ml: add tenant KV histograms to perf dashboard and create alert for >50 evictions/min (ETA 2h)
- sophia-oncall: write initial incident note and timestamp events (ETA 1h)

raj-runtime: Noted. I'll attach perf traces and a small repro harness to the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: incident:2143001234 update: policy patch applied, partial mitigation observed

liaison (customer-ops): thanks team — customer ops notified affected accounts; we'll follow up after RCA. :thumbsup:

tia-sre: Closing immediate paging. We'll reconvene in the incident doc thread for RCA. Thanks all for fast responses. :heart:
